chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 6B (Public Officers and Employees; Ethics; Conflicts of Interest; Financial Disclosure) codifies the WV Ethics Act, including Article 3 (Lobbyists) — the state's lobbying-disclosure regime.

notes: WV 2025 vintage available on Justia. WV lobbying-disclosure regime lives in Chapter 6B (Ethics Act), Articles 1-3 — registration, reports, definitions, ethics commission. No parallel lobbying chapter elsewhere in the WV Code.
